entities.summary: Pierre Olivier Sarközy de Nagy-Bocsa is a French banker based in the United States. His half-brother is Nicolas Sarkozy, the former President of France. Olivier Sarkozy was a performers & entertainers from Boulogne-Billancourt (b. 1969-05-26, Boulogne-Billancourt). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
